scope: Publication copies omit credential-bearing HTTP headers and opaque session/encrypted fields, including nested JSON and base64 representations. Only actual experiment-machine paths are aliased to /slb prefixes; synthetic task paths remain unchanged. Original cryptographic identities are retained with explicit publication hashes. Scoring data and Boolean outcomes are unchanged.
bindings: Every bundle file-map.jsonl records original and publication hashes. source-records.jsonl preserves source_line_sha256 and supplies publication_source_line_sha256 when redacted; protocol review records analogously use publication_record_sha256. protocol/publication-file-bindings.json binds changed frozen sources and metadata.
